scripts.text:
DROP INDEX IDX_MCD ON EXTRACT.HIP_Landing_zone_Phone_Numbers 
DROP INDEX IDX_PV ON EXTRACT.HIP_Landing_zone_Phone_Numbers

source.sqlReaderQuery: Select   	MBR.MasterConsumerID 	,CNTCT.Number 	,CNTCT.Primary_Value 	,CNTCT.ContactPhones_SeqNumber 	,CNTCT.PhoneConsent 	,CNTCT.InvalidFlag                 ,CNTCT.Type                 ,CNTCT.PhoneType 	,CNTCT.[CreatedDate] 	,CNTCT.LastModifiedDate  From [LandingZone].[dbo].[LZ_HIP_Member] MBR WITH (NOLOCK)  INNER JOIN [LandingZone].[dbo].[LZ_HIP_Member_ContactPhones] CNTCT WITH (NOLOCK) ON MBR.MemberID=CNTCT.MemberID and (CNTCT.InvalidFlag = 0 or CNTCT.InvalidFlag is NULL) WHERE (CNTCT.PhoneConsent in ('Consent','EXPRESSED CONSENT','Not Stated','NA') 	or CNTCT.PhoneConsent = '' 	or CNTCT.PhoneConsent is NULL)

scripts.text:
CREATE INDEX IDX_MCD ON EXTRACT.HIP_Landing_zone_Phone_Numbers (Masterconsumerid)
CREATE INDEX IDX_PV ON EXTRACT.HIP_Landing_zone_Phone_Numbers (Primary_Value)
